goalInOwnWords: Build a line of machines that turns scrap into things that sell for more, fill the money order each shift, and finish with more money than the foreman, Sal.
stoppedWhere: Results screen after finishing my first full game on today's yard (5 of 6 orders, two stars, $16,758, $906 behind Sal), right after sending the survey. The Play again button was in front of me.
stoppedWhy: I only stopped because the test's action budget ran out. Left to myself I would have pressed Play again straight away to beat Sal and get the third star: I missed the last order by $147 and I could see what to do better.

stuck.where: Shift 4 of today's yard, after the scrap truck dropped a Hopper and Crusher
stuck.what: The helper said no spot pays more with the Furnace and it can wait on the shelf, but I could not tell where the Crusher's shards should go to make money
stuck.gotOutHow: Put the Furnace where the Crusher sends and a Dock where the Furnace sends, then watched the money figure jump from $1,944 to $2,994 and fill the order

stuck.what: Short of the order and the helper again said nothing pays more; two spare Splitters on the shelf and no idea what they are for
stuck.gotOutHow: Moved a Dock one square over and put the Furnace in between by myself, using Move; the figure said the order would fill and it did. Never worked out the Splitters

confused: Lesson 1 said the job was 20 ingots and then paid me for scrap and shards first; I did not know where the ingots would come from until the Furnace card came up
'The others go back on the truck' when picking a card: what truck?
Leftover spare parts (belts, Splitters) sat on the shelf and nobody said what they are for
'Every price goes up 25%' on the job card: I did not know what that meant for my line until I saw the next shift's numbers
'You're $X behind Sal' kept growing for the first four shifts even though I filled every order, so I could not tell whether I was doing well
The helper line says 'nothing pays more yet' or 'fits this line now' when the real answer was different, so I did not know which words to trust
Big list of cards on the first shift of the real game with no hint of which suits me except 'fits this line now'
annoyed: The helper note was wrong at least twice ('No spot pays more with the Furnace yet') and nearly talked me out of a good move
Rearranging a belt with Move takes about four taps, and picking a part twice (shelf then yard) feels fussy
Small print and a screen that scrolls; the lit squares are hard to find after the card is picked
The tip about how to beat Sal (plan a shift ahead, make room) only shows up at the very end
Racing a made-up foreman whose score is far out of reach at the start
pleased: Lesson 1 and 2 walked me through step by step with one instruction at a time, and it worked every time
The 'this shift will pay' figure before pressing Start, and it was exactly right
Each shift's 'what held you back' box told me which machine was the slow one, like a fault finder
Fixing the line myself on shift 4 and watching the money figure jump
Undo gave my money figure back when a change made it worse
Nothing asked for money or tricked me until the survey question
bestMoment: Shift 4: no lit squares, I put a Furnace and a Dock where the stray Crusher was dumping shards, the figure jumped by a thousand, and the shift filled the order.
worstMoment: Missing the sixth order by $147 and the third star, and learning only on the results screen that Sal never moves a machine and that planning a shift ahead would have passed him.
oneChange: Tell me earlier, plainly, what a spare part or a stray machine is for and how to beat Sal, and make the helper line stop saying nothing pays more when something does. Then I would play it every day like my word games.
